title: Professional Demo Reel
description: Full demo reel showcasing character FX, rigging, cloth/hair simulation, muscle systems, and pipeline tools across multiple feature film productions.

title: Character FX Reel
description: Cloth, hair, and skin simulation work. Nucleus solver setups, nCloth/nHair configurations, and character deformation for feature animation.

title: Cloth & Hair Simulation
description: Detailed cloth and hair simulation tests. Showcasing Nucleus solver capabilities for realistic fabric and hair dynamics.

title: Muscle Simulation Pipeline
description: End-to-end muscle rigging and simulation. From skeleton to muscle to skin deformation with Ziva Dynamics-style setups. Includes turntable and transition views.

title: Houdini RBD Dynamics
description: Rigid body destruction, debris, and dirt simulation in Houdini. Procedural setup for large-scale destruction effects.

title: UE-WeatherFX
description: Procedural weather material shaders for Unreal Engine 5. Rain ripples, snow accumulation, wind animation, volumetric fog — all in HLSL, no textures required. Shared Material Parameter Collection for runtime control.

title: ue-assetaudit
description: Fast Rust CLI for auditing Unreal Engine project assets. Naming conventions, oversized textures, duplicates, broken references. Parses .uasset headers directly — no UE installation needed. CI-friendly JSON output.

title: Bevy Aurora
description: Real-time aurora borealis shader written in WGSL for the Bevy game engine. Procedural curtain effect with customizable colors, wave parameters, and performance-friendly rendering.

title: Bevy Radiance Cascades
description: Radiance cascade global illumination implementation in Bevy. Real-time indirect lighting for 2D/3D scenes using the radiance cascades algorithm.

title: Bevy Foliage Tool
description: Interactive foliage placement and scattering tool for Bevy. Procedural distribution with density maps, slope constraints, and real-time preview.

title: Heavy Objects Diagnostic Tool
description: Maya Python tool for diagnosing and optimizing heavy scenes. Includes proxifier, instancer, and reducer modules. 4-part video walkthrough.

title: Maya USD Author
description: Tool to author USD edits directly in Maya. PySide6 interface for stage editing, layer management, and property overrides.

title: Anvil
description: Rust-based package manager for VFX pipelines. Think Rez, but faster. YAML packages, dependency resolution, DCC launcher.
